statement.en: Where every member from member k on, k included, acts alike whatever its own coupling, on every list of earlier acts, a pool's acts are alike across worlds alike through the couplings of the members before k: they carry no more than what couples into those members, however many follow.
statement.zh: 自第 k 员起（含第 k 员），每员于每一前行之列皆不论其耦合而同行，则池之行于第 k 员前诸员之耦合无别之二世界皆同：其所载不逾彼诸员之所耦合入，后继者多寡不论。

laws.en: Members act in turn: member n by its law on its own coupling of the world and the list of the acts before it; from member k on, every member acting alike whatever its coupling, on every list of earlier acts, and two worlds alike through the couplings of the members before k, are named.
laws.zh: 成员依次而行：第 n 员依其律，于其对世界之耦合及其前之行之列而行；自第 k 员起每员于每一前行之列皆不论其耦合而同行，及于第 k 员前诸员之耦合无别之二世界，皆有名。

laws.en: From member k on, k included, where every member reads only the acts before it, two worlds alike through the couplings of the members before k give every member the same act, and the same list of acts at every length.
laws.zh: 自第 k 员起（含第 k 员）每员唯读其前之行，则于第 k 员前诸员之耦合无别之二世界，每员之行皆同，每一长之行列皆同。

laws.en: So every selection reading the list of the first N acts, for any N, selects alike any two worlds alike through the couplings of the members before k.
laws.zh: 故凡读首 N 行之列之选，不论 N，于第 k 员前诸员之耦合无别之二世界皆同选。

laws.en: After the same earlier acts, a member acts differently in two worlds exactly where its law tells apart the values they give its coupling.
laws.zh: 前行相同之后，一员于二世界行异，恰当其律分二世界予其耦合之值。

laws.en: Copying: the first member acts on its own coupling and every later one copies the first act before it; it is a cascade from the second member, and two worlds alike through the first member's coupling give every member the same act.
laws.zh: 相仿：首员依其耦合而行，其后每员仿其前之首行；此自第二员起为级联，于首员之耦合无别之二世界，每员之行皆同。

hypotheses.en: Any types of worlds, couplings and acts; members indexed by the natural numbers, each reading the whole list of acts before it.
hypotheses.zh: 世界、耦合与行之任一型；成员以自然数为序，各读其前之全部行列。

hypotheses.en: From member k on, k included, every member acts alike whatever its own coupling, on every list of earlier acts, histories no run reaches included; member k's coupling is then not read, so it is not among those the acts reach.
hypotheses.zh: 自第 k 员起（含第 k 员），每员于每一前行之列（未行至之史亦然）皆不论其耦合而同行；故第 k 员之耦合不为所读，不在诸行所及之中。

does_not_show.en: When an actual member stops reading its own coupling: in the probabilistic model (Bikhchandani, Hirshleifer and Welch 1992), once the public evidence outweighs any private signal, a premise here.
does_not_show.zh: 实际之员何时不复读其耦合：于概率之模型（Bikhchandani 等 1992），公示之据重于任一私讯之时；此处为前提。

does_not_show.en: That a cascade errs: it suppresses what later members' couplings carry, and can be accurate.
does_not_show.zh: 级联必误：其抑后员之耦合所载者，可为准。

does_not_show.en: That a pool's later selection keeps a coupling one member's act carries.
does_not_show.zh: 池之后选存一员之行所载之耦合。

does_not_show.en: Weighted averaging (DeGroot 1974) and its wisdom condition (Golub and Jackson 2010); a bound depending on who reads whom (laws ignoring some earlier acts are covered); members in no well-founded order.
does_not_show.zh: 加权平均（DeGroot 1974）及其智之条件（Golub 与 Jackson 2010）；依谁读谁之界（不读某些前行之律已含）；无良基之序之成员。

detail.en: Copying: worlds differing in every member's coupling but the first give every member the same act (Turns.Copying.reaches_first_only).
detail.zh: 相仿：除首员外每员之耦合皆异之二世界，每员之行皆同（Turns.Copying.reaches_first_only）。

validation_scope.en: Pure core, every axiom report empty: Cascade imports Learning for Training.Through only; the acts are built by recursion on the number of members.
validation_scope.zh: 纯核，公理报告皆空：Cascade 引 Learning 唯为 Training.Through；诸行以成员之数递归而建。

next_delta.en: The probabilistic form, a cascade once public evidence outweighs every private signal; a run of the frozen test of where sequential choosers meet the premise at the histories reached (TR3, resting on a-cascade-at-the-histories-reached), a named probabilistic model's timing judged apart; review by a person.
next_delta.zh: 概率之形，公示之据重于每一私讯时之级联；依次之择者于所至之历何处合此前提之冻结检验之运行（TR3，依 a-cascade-at-the-histories-reached），具名之概率模型之时机另判；人之审查。

correspondence.en: The deterministic form of an information cascade (Bikhchandani, Hirshleifer and Welch 1992; Banerjee 1992), where the act has stopped reading the member's own signal; WitnessRefinementRuns.copied_witnesses_same is a neighbour, where copied witnesses add nothing under its further hypotheses. AI reading: copying as the dependence failure of Condorcet's jury theorem; echo chambers, or evaluators trained on one another's verdicts, under the cascade premise. These are readings, not containments.
correspondence.zh: 信息级联之定形（Bikhchandani、Hirshleifer 与 Welch 1992；Banerjee 1992），行已不读员之私讯者；WitnessRefinementRuns.copied_witnesses_same 为其邻，其另加诸前提下仿制之证人无所增。AI 解读：相仿为 Condorcet 陪审定理之依存之失；回声室，或以彼此之判而训之评者，于级联之前提下。皆为读，非包含。

detail.en: Training.Through, the selection through a relation of being alike.

A pool reaches no further than the union of its members' closures; where, from some member on, every member reads only the acts before it, a selection through the acts reaches only what couples into the members before that one.
detail.zh: 池之所及不逾其诸员之闭包之并；自某员起每员唯读其前之行之处，经诸行之选唯及彼员前诸员之所耦合入。

detail.en: This record's cascade laws (acts, act, selection through the acts) with the premise asked only at the histories a world reaches, for the two couplings compared at one of the two worlds, and for the selection at every world; this record's premise gives it; weaker by a witness, member 0 reading its coupling only after a non-empty list of earlier acts, which no world gives it.
detail.zh: 本记录之级联诸律（行、一员之行、经诸行之选），前提唯问于一世界所至之历，于所比二世界之一、所比之二耦合；于选，则于每一世界；本记录之前提予之；以一见证为较弱：第 0 员唯于非空之前行列后读其耦合，而无一世界予之以此列。
